Title: Veil the Legions vs Mask of a Thousand Faces

Messages.Author: Jeff Kuta
Messages.Body:
Vamps A and B have superior Obfuscate and more than 3 blood. Vamp X is
controlled by an adjacent Methuselah.

Vamp A bleeds. Vamp X tries to block. Vamp B plays Veil the Legions at
OBF and burns 2 blood for 2 extra stealthy actions. Vamp X gains 1
intercept. Vamp B plays Mask of a Thousand Faces at OBF and take over,
gaining 1 more stealth. Vamp X fails to block.

Is this a legal play?

I think it is. Vamp A played no cards that Vamp B could not and there
are no other restrictions preventing Vamp B from taking over.

Thanks in advance.

Jeff
